application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Proposed increase in size of front garage doors.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Existing Front Elevation; Unreferenced Proposed Front Elevation
Received:  13 April 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the replacement front garage doors hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - The replacement front garage doors shall be centrally positioned within the front elevation width of the existing single storey attached side garage.
